faq.description: Find answers to commonly asked questions about our service.

security.question: How secure is my data on KIZERE?
security.answer: We use industry-standard encryption protocols to protect your data. All personal information and item details are encrypted both in transit and at rest, and we regularly perform security audits to ensure your data remains safe.

items.question: What types of items can I register?
items.answer: You can register almost any valuable item including electronics, jewelry, documents, accessories, and more. Our system is particularly effective for items with unique identifiers like serial numbers, IMEI numbers, or other distinguishing characteristics.

lostFound.question: How does the lost and found process work?
lostFound.answer: When someone finds your item, they can scan the QR code attached to it. This notifies you immediately and provides the finder with a secure, private way to initiate the return, keeping your personal contact details hidden until you choose to share them.

limits.question: Is there a limit to how many items I can register?
limits.answer: Basic accounts can register up to 5 items. Premium subscribers can register unlimited items and access additional features like priority support and enhanced recovery services.

faq.contactUs: Can't find your answer? Contact our support team.

faqs_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs_page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about KIZERE

questions.what_is_kizere_ans: KIZERE is Rwanda's first comprehensive digital platform for item registration, lost and found reporting, and ownership management. We help build a culture of trust and security.
questions.is_it_free_ans: Registering a basic account is free. Protecting an item costs just 2,000 RWF.
questions.how_to_register: How do I register an item?
questions.how_to_register_ans: Simply log in, click 'Register Item', and follow the steps: provide details, upload photos, and verify ownership documents.
questions.what_is_digital_cert_ans: It's a secure digital document that proves you are the owner of the item. It includes item details, photos, and a unique identification number.
questions.what_if_i_lose_it: What should I do if I lose my item?
questions.what_if_i_lose_it_ans: Go to 'Lost & Found', report the item as lost, and provide details about where and when it was last seen. Our network and matching algorithm will help find it.
questions.is_my_data_safe_ans: Yes, we use bank-level encryption and comply with Rwanda's data protection laws to ensure your personal information is secure.

faqs_page.contact_us_text: Still have questions? We're here to help you secure what matters most.

about_page.title: About KIZERE
about_page.mission_text: To build a transparent and trustworthy environment for item ownership and recovery in Rwanda through innovative digital solutions.
about_page.vision_text: To become the standard for ownership verification and lost-item recovery across East Africa.
about_page.story_text: Founded in Kigali, KIZERE was born out of the need for a central, reliable system to manage property and facilitate the return of lost items in our growing city.
